tasks.short: Record observed plant and growth information

steps.what: Observe plants and obtain the actual growth measurements
Enter plant identity and growth facts in the existing crop record
Check plant, date, units and recorded growth values

tasks.design: Configure the existing crop-recording application {OTHER} to retain the selected crop/location and offer its existing plant identifiers. The farmworker still obtains and enters actual growth measurements and checks the complete original record; no automated plant assessment or additional record is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated plant/location identification interrupts entry of actual growth observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native crop selection can reuse stable identifiers within a recording round.
tasks.still_hard: Plant identity changes, inconsistent measurements and unusual growth require direct observation.
tasks.human_edge: The farmworker knows whether the measurement belongs to the actual plant and is credible.
tasks.altitude: Observation and record responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: LetsGrow supports registering plants and clusters directly in the greenhouse; no measured time saving is supplied by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is an existing plant-growth recording round. The record is already used by growers for crop management, not a new trailing activity log. Confirm manual repeated identifiers before using this provisional baseline.

Growers already maintain crop/batch, plant/location identifier and measurement definitions. s1 produces actual measurement, unit, time and observed condition, including physical measurement. s2 retains original value entry and missing-identifier capture; no camera, sensor feed or free tagging is assumed.

Native crop-context selection first. It removes 5.25 points of repeated stable identifier/location entry, leaving 29.75 points for values, changed identifiers, manual fallback and ordinary ungated saving. s3 retains complete identity/unit/value checking and correction. More repair lowers the estimate; runtime is not labour.
Shares and upkeep are model estimates. No grower decision or separate external send is automated.
unknowns: Whether identifiers are already retained by the app
Current recording fields and plant-identity changes
research_questions: Can crop context persist without carrying a previous plant's values into the next entry?

already_counted.description: Actual growth measurement, original value entry, identifier repair and complete record checking.

incremental.description: Maintain crop/location selection settings after planting changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 5.25 repeated-identifier points less one upkeep. Conservative mixed-variety propagation round has frequent location and plant changes, leaving only 1.3 points of stable context reusable: 0.3 net. Physical observation and ordinary saving remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain nursery supply inventory and order needed materials

steps.what: Count usable pots, growing media and other required materials
Update the existing material inventory record
Compare material stock with approved replenishment quantities
Prepare the existing supplier material order
Check final material need, packs, price and supplier destination
Send the checked material order to the supplier

tasks.design: Configure the nursery inventory module in {OPS_SYSTEM} to compare counted materials with existing approved requirements and populate an order in {PROCUREMENT}. The worker retains usable-stock inspection, original count entry, final quantity/pack checks and the separately gated real supplier send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Known material quantities and identifiers are repeatedly compared and copied into orders.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock views and catalogue order fields can reuse existing identifiers and requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Damaged supplies, seasonal demand and incompatible pack units need practical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The worker knows whether the supplies are usable and the proposed replenishment fits the crop work.
tasks.altitude: Inventory and delegated order responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: inventory and procurement modules can compare explicit supply requirements and populate fixed material-order fields.

assumptions: Boundary is a material inventory/order cycle performed by a worker with existing delegated buying authority. A site requiring grower or purchasing approval needs that actual actor and time before the send; do not assume authority or transfer review free.

s1 produces usable count and unit. Existing grower planning supplies material requirement/threshold; purchasing supplies material identifier, supplier, price and pack conversion. s2 includes manual capture, checking and missing-mapping repair. No new stock capture or catalogue maintenance is free.

Try native stock and order templates first. s2 removes two points of repeated material identifiers, leaving 18 for original count entry, checking, repair and ordinary ungated saving. s3 removes explicit quantity comparison; s4 fixed order population. s5 retains need, pack, price and destination judgement plus manual fallback; excess repair lowers savings.

s6 is a real supplier order, separated and approved only after the final payload exists. Its one point remains fully retained with no saving. Edits to quantities, price or destination void approval. Shares are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Worker buying authority and actual approval path
research_questions: Can native fields distinguish pots, trays and bulk growing-media units?
Observe counting separately from comparison and order typing

already_counted.description: Count usable stock, enter original counts and check or repair complete orders.

incremental.description: Maintain material-unit mappings and approved replenishment settings.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final material order, quantities, packs, price and supplier destination; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes two identifier, 15 comparison and 15 order-field points less 1.5 upkeep. Conservative mixed seasonal supplies have incompatible packs and new needs: only 0.5 identifier, three comparison and two standard order points disappear, leaving four net. Counting and send time remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect plants and bud ties to judge quality

steps.what: Review the applicable plant and bud-tie quality requirements
Inspect plant condition, bud ties and visible defects
Assess plant and bud-tie quality against the requirements

tasks.design: Keep physical plant and bud-tie inspection with the farmworker. The existing quality instruction in {DOCS} remains a reference; no image system or automatic quality decision is established by the digest.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on examining actual plant and tie condition.
tasks.enabler_now: No labour-removing digital change is established for these inspection operations.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle damage, tie tension and variable plant development need direct inspection.
tasks.human_edge: The farmworker recognises whether a tie is damaging the plant or failing to support it.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: plant and bud-tie inspection requires physical condition assessment; the digest's crop-record apps do not establish automatic inspection capability.

assumptions: Boundary is the stated physical inspection and quality judgement. No routine quality log is established. Any actual grade/reject tally, plant marking, corrective-work instruction or separate report/send must be added if part of today's inspection rather than folded into observation.

Grower instructions already supply inspection criteria; s1 includes retrieval, reading and manual clarification. s2 produces direct observations. No new structured image, measurement capture or camera installation is assumed.

Before choosing zero, separate reference review from physical inspection and inspect actual record and send duties. Native templates do not remove this brief criteria review or the physical assessment. Do not invent a trailing inspection record nobody uses.
No new technology or ongoing capture is introduced, so upkeep is zero. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Actual quality tally or marking requirements
research_questions: Observe a plant inspection and separately time any actual tally, marking or escalation

incremental.description: No technology or new capture is introduced for this physical inspection.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Criteria review, plant examination and quality judgement remain fully retained. No existing removable record, send or repetitive digital operation is established in this inspection boundary.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A farmworker retaining physical observation and quality judgement while native crop and inventory forms reduce demonstrated repetition.
skills_to_grow: Check crop identity and measurement units
Validate material packs and delegated order authority
role.ambitious_version: Use existing records reliably without adding unpriced data capture or replacing physical plant inspection.
